newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Monday, as active technical buying emerged after price losses last week, traders said.
Prices were 40 to 180 yen lower, with the benchmark July 1998 contract up 40 yen at 13,790 yen per tonne.

Technical buying from local investors emerged from the opening, supporting all contracts, traders said. "We assumed the benchmark July was unlikely to drop sharply from the 14,000 yen levels," a trader at a brokerage house said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.62-3/4 per bushel at 0635 GMT, down from $2.65-1/2 at Friday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.23-1/4 a bushel at 0635 GMT, against $8.26 at Friday's close.
